335: The main protagonist of the story. He moved from his home in rural Hiroshima to his aunt’s dormitory in Tokyo to change himself. While checking out his new high school, he sees a beautiful high jumper practicing and falls in love at first sight.
336: A talented female high jumper from Yokohama that was scouted by many famous high schools because of her skill. While in Tokyo, she lives in Ayano’s dormitory, next door to Yamato.
120753: An up and coming idol whose CD "reached the top of the charts in just one week." She is a childhood friend of Yuu. She calls Yuu "Niko-kun" and he refers to her as "Tama-chan.
120754: Yuu Haruna moved to Tokyo and started high school there because his parents were moved to America for business. He lives with his 3 sisters Hibiki, Mayu, and Chitose. He uses Twitter often and posts about his life whenever he gets the opportunity.
120757: An upperclassman of Fuuka and Yuu. He originally wanted Fuuka to join the school's track team, which he was the captain of, but he was later persuaded to join Fuuka's band instead. He plays the drums.
120929: One of Yuu's three sisters. She refers to herself in the third-person.
120931: A senpai at the same school as Yuu and Fuuka, she is the younger sister of Hisashi.
120933: Yuu's second-oldest sister who attends college.
120934: A friend and classmate of Fuuka and Yuu. He has both British and German heritage in addition to Japanese. Mikasa is popular and well liked by everyone in class and considered to be very good looking.
120935: She is the former keyboardist of Hedgehogs.
